title: Running with an oracle and choice sequence
statement: Given an oracle nondeterministic Turing machine, an oracle language, a finite sequence of nondeterministic choice bits, and a configuration, the resulting configuration is obtained by processing the choice bits in order, applying one oracle-machine step for each bit.
hypotheses_covered: An oracle language over its symbol alphabet
A finite sequence of Boolean choice bits
